question: ‘Wings of Fire’ is the autobiography of _______.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Wings of Fire**' is the autobiography of **APJ Abdul Kalam**, the **11th President of India** & a renowned **aerospace scientist**. 
 
• This book is an inspiring journey of Kalam from his humble beginnings in** Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu**, to becoming a pivotal figure in **India's space & missile development programs.** 
 
• It delves into his personal challenges & achievements, emphasizing the power of education, hard work, & perseverance.
 
• Kalam's story is a testament to the impact **one individual can have on the advancement of a nation.**
 
• All these make 'Wings of Fire' a must-read for anyone seeking motivation & insight into the life of a visionary.
